fields.Name: IT120 - Server-Set Query Parameters and Approvals
fields.Description: Server-transport bundle (#4789 A17). Creates a throwaway query whose ChapterID parameter is marked IsServerSet and approves it, then proves: a caller value for ChapterID (the only channel a GraphQL client has) is refused, naming it, and logged; server code sets it through RunQueryParams.ServerParameters; the approval is bound to a fingerprint of the definition, so editing the SQL to D2 without re-approval makes a RequireApproved run refuse while restoring D1 exactly makes it run again, and IsServerSet survives each SQL edit; and a template's Context.UserID renders the context user while a caller value for Context is refused and extraction keeps no Context parameter row. Self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A server-set parameter can only be set by server code; an approval is current only for the exact definition approved; Context comes from the server.
